dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agencies involved in law enforcement, homeland security, and foreign affairs, as well as individuals targeted by transnational cyber-enabled crime.
dimensions.evidence: To codify certain policies to combat transnational cyber-enabled crime, and for other purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Elevates existing executive orders and a presidential memorandum to statutory status, formalizing established administrative policies.
dimensions.evidence: A covered order or memorandum shall have the force and effect of law.

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state or clearly imply any federal spending, revenue, or specific economic effects.
